d.t: Fast curing styrene free chemical anchoring adhesive
d.s: Solvent and styrene free based, two-component polyester anchoring adhesive.
a: Can be used at low temperatures
us: As a fast curing anchoring adhesive for all grades of:

* These substrates may vary greatly, in particular with regard to strength, composition and porosity. Therefore, for each application the suitability of Sika AnchorFix-1 Adhesive must be tested by first applying Sika AnchorFix-1 Adhesive only to a sample area. Check in particular bond strength, surface staining and discolouration.

sec.t: Complies to NCC 2019 reference to AS 5216:2018 - Design of post-installed and cast-in fastenings in concrete Injection system for use in masonry according to ETAG 029, ETA-12/0227, Declaration of Performance 020403010010000001 5034408, certified by notified product certification body 0679, certificate of constancy of performance 0679-DPD-0777, and provided with the CE marking Bonded injection type anchor for non cracked concrete according to ETAG 001 annex 1 and 5, ETA-13/0720, Declaration of Performance 020403010010000001 5034408, certified by notified product certification body 1020, certificate of constancy of performance 1020-CPD-090-029816, and provided with the CE marking.
12 months from date of production All Sika AnchorFix-1 cartridges have the expiry date printed on the label.
Stored properly in original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C. Protect from direct sunlight.
~1.63 kg/l (component A+B mixed)
~60 N/mm2 (7 days, +20 °C) | (ASTM D 695)
~28 N/mm2 (7 days, +20 °C) | (ASTM D 790)
~12 N/mm2 (7 days, +20 °C) | (ASTM D 638)
Long term | +50 °C Short term (1–2 hours) | +80 °C
+60 °C | (DIN EN ISO 6721-1)
For details about adhesive anchoring design refer to the separate documentation provided: “Technical Documentation Sika AnchorFix-1” Ref: 870 43 01
Component A : component B = 10 : 1 by volume
3 mm max.
Non-sag, even overhead
Sika AnchorFix-1 must be at a temperature of between +5 °C and +40 °C for application.
-10 °C min. / +40 °C max.
Beware of condensation. Substrate temperature during application must be at least 3 °C above dew point.
-10 °C min. / +40 °C max.

Temperature | Open time - Tgel | Curing time - Tcur +30 °C | 4 minutes | 35 minutes +25 °C – +30 °C | 4 minutes | 40 minutes +20 °C – +25 °C | 5 minutes | 50 minutes +10 °C – +20 °C | 6 minutes | 85 minutes +5 °C – +10 °C | 10 minutes | 145 minutes +5 °C | 18 minutes | 145 minutes –10 °C 1 2 | 30 minutes | 24 hours 1 Minimum cartridge temperature: +5 °C 2 This application is not covered by the scope of the product ETA or any other approval.

Mortar and concrete must be at the required strength. No need to be 28 days old. Substrate strength (concrete, masonry, natural stone) must be verified. Pull-out tests must be carried out if the substrate strength is unknown. The anchor hole must always be clean, dry, free from oil and grease etc. Loose particles must be removed from the holes. Threaded rods and rebars have to be cleaned thoroughly from any oil, grease or any other substances and particles such as dirt etc.

Getting the cartridge ready: 300 ml / 550 ml 1. Unscrew the cap 2. Cut the film 3. Screw on the static mixer 4. Place the cartridge into the gun and start application When the work is interrupted the static mixer can remain on the cartridge after the gun pressure has been relieved. If the resin has hardened in the nozzle when work is resumed, a new nozzle must be attached.
Clean tools and application equipment with Sika Colma Cleaner immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.

handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection

hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary.
